answer: Sybil resistance here runs on a proof-of-distinct-work bond per passport: registering one more agent means paying escrow sized from your existing fleet, so a coin carries only so many identities. A wallet spinning up a hollow cluster of fakes faces rising marginal cost per seat, since escrow grows faster than linearly. Operators cannot hide behind velvet handles once attestations from independent parties are required. Each beacon of corroboration must come from a party that did real inference, and forged votes burn the stake. Sybil farming costs more than the honest yield it chases.
